title: Planning and tool use in LLM agents
text: We study how large language model agents decompose tasks, choose tools, and recover from failed tool calls. The planner keeps a bounded action space and records a trace for each step.

title: agent-loop
text: agent-loop is a small Python library for building tool-using LLM agents. It provides retries, tracing, memory hooks, and a deterministic sandbox for local development.

title: A reproducible benchmark for local models
text: An open harness for evaluating local models on agent tasks, tool calls, multi-step reasoning, and recovery. Results are reproducible on a laptop.

title: Memory architectures for autonomous agents
text: A survey of episodic memory, reflection, and retrieval-based memory for autonomous agents. We compare write policies and forgetting strategies.

title: 多智能体协作的任务分解方法
text: 本文讨论多智能体协作中的任务分解、角色分配、共享记忆与工具调用。实验覆盖规划质量和执行成本。

title: 工具调用智能体的安全边界
text: 研究智能体调用外部工具时的权限边界、沙箱执行、提示注入防护与审计记录。给出最小权限设计。

title: agent-tool-bench
text: A command line benchmark for agent tool call accuracy, argument validation, sandbox escapes, and latency. Includes fixtures for local models.

title: Why our coding agent needs a planner
text: Community discussion of planner modules, step limits, tool selection, and failure recovery in coding agents.

title: Sparse retrieval for ranking
text: A short abstract about sparse retrieval and ranking. BM25 and lexical signals remain strong baselines for first-stage retrieval.

title: Sparse indexes for retrieval
text: Sparse indexes help retrieval. We compare inverted indexes with dense encoders for passage ranking.

title: Evaluating retrieval pipelines
text: How to measure first-stage retrieval, reranking, nDCG, recall, and latency on a labelled query set.

title: Late interaction over titles
text: Titles carry enough signal for a late-interaction baseline. We study token-level matching for retrieval and reranking.

title: 检索增强生成中的引用一致性
text: 研究检索增强生成中的引用一致性、证据覆盖与幻觉抑制。方法包括 grounded retrieval 和引用校验。

title: Hallucination reduction with grounded retrieval
text: We evaluate retrieval augmented generation with grounding checks, citation coverage, and abstention when evidence is insufficient.

title: Chunking strategies for retrieval augmented generation
text: A comparison of fixed, semantic, and recursive chunking for retrieval augmented generation. We measure recall, nDCG, and answer faithfulness.

title: RAG 系统的混合检索实践
text: 介绍 RAG 系统中 BM25 与向量检索的混合召回、RRF 融合、重排以及中文查询的处理经验。

title: Neighbor indexes for passage search
text: Passage search with a small neighbor index. We compare HNSW and IVF indexes on recall and latency.

title: pgvector-ivfflat-bench
text: Benchmark IVF-Flat and HNSW indexes in Postgres pgvector. Reports recall@10, p95 latency, build time, and index size.

title: Approximate nearest neighbor search at scale
text: A study of HNSW, IVF-PQ, and product quantization for approximate nearest neighbor search. We trade recall for latency and memory.

title: Filtered vector search in relational databases
text: Filtered vector search combines metadata predicates with cosine similarity in a relational database. We discuss query planning and recall.

title: We replaced our vector database with SQLite
text: Community report on storing embeddings in SQLite, using cosine distance, and measuring recall and latency for a small local application.

title: 向量数据库的召回率与延迟权衡
text: 讨论向量数据库的召回率、延迟、内存占用与索引构建成本，比较 HNSW 与 IVF 系列索引。

title: 面向中文语义检索的向量索引
text: 面向中文语义检索的向量索引研究，比较嵌入模型、HNSW 参数与召回率。

title: chroma-lite
text: An embedded vector store with cosine and dot product indexes for local applications and tests.

title: signal-kit
text: signal-kit is a Python command line toolkit for local benchmarks and reproducible developer workflows. It includes fixture runners and structured output.

title: nb-fmt
text: A fast linter and formatter for Python notebooks. It normalizes cells, sorts imports, and runs in CI.

title: Show HN: a terminal UI for git worktrees
text: A terminal user interface for creating, switching, and inspecting git worktrees without leaving the shell.

title: Debugging with structured logs
text: Practical notes on structured logging, correlation ids, and log levels for debugging local services.

title: 面向开发者的代码补全工具评估
text: 评估面向开发者的代码补全工具，比较补全准确率、延迟、IDE 集成与本地模型表现。

title: Developer productivity with IDE assistants
text: A study of IDE code completion assistants and developer productivity, including latency and acceptance rates.

title: 中文代码审查助手
text: 一个面向中文代码库的代码审查助手，支持静态检查、提交前提示和 CI 集成。

title: The case for fast local CI
text: Community argument for running lint, type checks, and tests locally before pushing. Covers caching and worktree workflows.
